title: Deux formations, deux priorités
summary: A career adviser helps Léa compare course requirements, time costs and the uncertainty around an internship.

sentences.fr: Léa comparait deux formations qui menaient à des emplois similaires, mais dont les horaires différaient.
sentences.en: Léa was comparing two programs that led to similar jobs but had different schedules.

sentences.fr: La première, à laquelle elle pouvait assister le soir, exigeait un stage de deux journées par semaine.
sentences.en: The first, which she could attend in the evening, required an internship of two days a week.

sentences.fr: La seconde offrait davantage de cours en ligne, ce qui réduirait ses déplacements, mais elle commençait plus tôt.
sentences.en: The second offered more online classes, which would reduce her travel, but it started earlier.

sentences.fr: Léa a demandé si les heures de stage pouvaient être regroupées; la réponse dépendait encore de l'employeur.
sentences.en: Léa asked whether the internship hours could be grouped together; the answer still depended on the employer.

sentences.fr: Elle a comparé le temps de transport, les frais et les compétences qu'elle souhaitait développer.
sentences.en: She compared travel time, fees and the skills she wanted to develop.

sentences.fr: À son avis, la première formation serait préférable si le stage pouvait être organisé autour de son horaire actuel.
sentences.en: In her view, the first program would be preferable if the internship could be arranged around her current schedule.

sentences.fr: Avant de s'engager, elle a demandé une confirmation écrite plutôt que de traiter une possibilité comme une promesse.
sentences.en: Before committing, she asked for written confirmation instead of treating a possibility as a promise.
sentences.note: A good comparison distinguishes confirmed requirements from details that still depend on another person or organization.

quiz.prompt: What was a requirement of the first program?
options: An internship for two days each week
quiz.explain: The second sentence gives the first program's internship requirement.

options: Whether the employer could group the internship hours
Whether both programs led to similar jobs
Whether Léa wanted to develop skills
Whether the second program started earlier
quiz.explain: The fourth sentence says the answer depended on the employer.

quiz.prompt: Why did Léa ask for written confirmation?
options: The adviser had already guaranteed the schedule
She needed to change the course fees
She wanted to cancel both programs
She did not want to treat a possibility as a promise
quiz.explain: The last sentence explains her reason directly.
